correctness.rationale: The fully specified finite matching is complete and acyclic on 910 faces, and 453 exact matched pairs reduce to critical-cell dimensions 0,2,2,3. A signed integral Morse-boundary computation (not a field-only check) verifies vanishing of the sole 3-to-2 attaching degree. A two-sphere wedge has π2=H2 by Hurewicz, hence the 3-cell attaches nullhomotopically and the exact wedge type follows. Separate complete matching certificates for m=6,7 leave one 0- and one 1-cell, proving circles. Full mod-two reductions independently corroborate all Betti ranks.

value.rationale: The fully-three-stable two-subset graphs are a canonical next family beyond Schrijver graphs; determining their actual box-complex topology is explicitly motivated by the 2023 research survey. The exact m=8 result is the first mixed-dimensional stage after two circle stages: nonzero integral homotopy in both degrees two and three prevents simple one-sphere generalization, and it gives a natural finite threshold relevant to topological chromatic methods. Its complete integral homotopy content is substantive beyond Euler counts or field Betti numbers.
